articles.title: Ethereum's Vitalik Buterin is rethinking how DeFi handles market crashes
articles.snippet: In a research post published Monday, Buterin proposed creating index-tracking assets using options contracts rather than the debt-based structures that underpin much of DeFi today.

articles.title: Whitehat developer unlocks $2 million stuck in a 2016 Ethereum ICO contract for nine years
articles.snippet: 0xflorent, a security researcher, found an integer-overflow flaw in the HongCoin token sale contract that lets the team unlock funds for 48 original investors. It is the second such recovery he has publicized in eight days.

articles.title: Three Sui mainnet halts in 48 hours traced to an upgrade bug by developers
articles.snippet: The Sui Foundation's post-mortem published Sunday traces all three outages to interactions between a new address-balance feature shipped in the v1.72 release and the network's existing gas and consensus logic.

articles.title: Strategy sells 32 BTC in first Bitcoin sale since 2022; Stock falls on open
articles.snippet: The world's largest public Bitcoin holder reduced its stash to 843,706 BTC, while raising $128.3 million through Class A stock sales.

articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX Warns $1.75 Billion IPO Investors of Potential Future Share Dilution
articles.snippet: SpaceX's amended IPO filing signals the company may issue substantial new shares in future transactions as Elon Musk expands its ambitions.
